description: Code-quality sweeps. These issues describe very large counts (476 console.error, 271+/156 any, 1686+ eslint-disable, 361 deprecated apiError imports, ~150 useEffect+fetch). A single pass cannot eliminate all of them without unacceptable risk, so this feature makes BOUNDED, verifiable reductions on the highest-value, lowest-risk targets and documents remaining scope. Addresses #1341, #1340, #1301, #1268, #1269, #1063 (any/console/logError), #1302/#1064 (AbortController), #1069 (Window any), #1222 (deprecated apiError), #1300/#1093 (response format), #1070 (CSP), #1342 (form validation), #422 (large files). Do NOT increase the ESLint warning budget; every change must keep typecheck/lint green.
steps: #1069 Window any (self-contained, do fully): In types/env.d.ts remove the `interface Window { [key: string]: any }` index signature. Replace with typed declarations for the specific window properties the app actually uses (grep for `window.` accesses that would break, e.g. window.__NEXT_DATA__, any analytics globals, __NUCRM_* flags). Fix any resulting type errors by typing those properties on the Window interface. Run typecheck to confirm nothing regressed.

#1063 console.error -> logError (bounded): In app/api route handlers, replace raw `console.error(err)` in catch blocks with `logError({ error: err, context: '<route>', ...tenantMeta(ctx) })` from @/lib/errors-server, using the tenantMeta helper already provided. Scope this to a coherent, sizeable subset (e.g. all app/api/tenant/** routes, or as many as can be done safely) rather than every one of the 261; keep logError calls non-blocking-appropriate (it is async — either await in the catch or fire with .catch). Record before/after console.error counts in findings and list which route trees were converted vs deferred.

#1340/#1301 frontend console.* (bounded): In app/ page files and components/, remove debug console.log/console.warn statements or gate genuinely-useful ones behind `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development')`. Prioritize settings/superadmin/portal pages and data-table components named in the issues. Keep legitimate console.error that surfaces real client errors, or route them through lib/errors-client.ts if that is the established pattern. Record counts before/after.

#1341/#1268/#1269 any + eslint-disable (bounded): Remove `any` + its eslint-disable in the top-offender files where a correct type is straightforward (reports/custom/page.tsx, settings/admin/page.tsx, settings/integrations/page.tsx, tasks/page.tsx, components/tenant/workflow-builder.tsx, tasks-client.tsx, sequences-client.tsx). Prefer real interfaces, generics, or `unknown` + type guards. Do NOT introduce new anys elsewhere. This will not clear all 1686; document how many disables were removed and that the remainder is deferred as ongoing tech-debt.

#1302/#1064 AbortController (bounded): Add AbortController + cleanup to useEffect+fetch hooks in a representative, high-traffic subset of pages/components. Pattern: `useEffect(() => { const c = new AbortController(); load(c.signal); return () => c.abort(); }, [])` and thread signal into fetch. Only convert effects whose loader can accept a signal without deep refactor; skip SWR/one-shot mount effects that already guard against unmount. Document which files were converted.

#1222 deprecated apiError (bounded / low-risk): Do NOT bulk-rewrite 361 imports. Instead, make the deprecated path safe: verify whether lib/api-error.ts already routes through logError/Sentry; if it does not, wire lib/api-error.ts's error path to also call logError (so the 361 existing callers gain Sentry/DB logging without touching each call site). If that is not feasible without behavior change, migrate a small representative set of routes to handleError() from lib/errors.ts and document the rest as deferred. Prefer the central-shim approach as it is lowest risk and highest coverage.

#1300/#1093 response format (bounded, additive): Do NOT break existing clients. Read AGENTS.md's { data, meta?, error? } convention. For the superadmin routes enumerated in #1093, add the { data, ... } envelope in a backward-compatible way ONLY if the corresponding client can be updated in the same change; otherwise document the inconsistency and standardize the newest/least-consumed routes. Record which routes were standardized and confirm their client callers were updated in lockstep so nothing breaks.

#1070 CSP (scoped to safe tightenings only): Per the maintainer comment already in next.config.mjs, script-src 'unsafe-inline' is required by Next.js hydration and full nonce-based removal is Issue #657 (OUT of scope for this bucket). Do NOT remove script-src unsafe-inline. Apply only the safe hardening already noted (object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-src, worker-src) if any are missing, and if styled-jsx usage can be audited, evaluate removing style-src unsafe-inline only if it does not break the app (verify by loading the app). If unsafe-inline cannot be safely removed, leave the config as-is and document that #1070 requires #657 nonce middleware — mark that sub-item deferred, retryable false.

#1342 form validation (bounded): Add missing client-side validation to the forms listed (SMS phone format, subscription amount non-negative, tickets reply required, webhooks require >=1 event, SLA/tax numeric bounds, form-builder non-empty labels, portal ticket description minLength, custom fields Zod before POST). Use the existing zod schemas / input validation patterns. Do as many as are low-risk; document any deferred.

#422 large files (document only, minimal action): Full refactor of 25+ files is out of scope for a polish bucket. Do NOT split large files speculatively. Instead record #422 as acknowledged/deferred in findings with a recommended split plan, unless a specific file touched by other features can be trivially extracted. Note that _registry.ts (3745 lines) is generated and should not be hand-split.
acceptance_criteria: types/env.d.ts no longer has `[key: string]: any` on Window and typecheck is still green (#1069 fully done).
A documented, non-trivial reduction in app/api console.error occurrences via logError, with before/after counts in findings (#1063).
A documented reduction in frontend console.log/console.warn (or dev-gating) with counts (#1340/#1301).
The named any/eslint-disable offender files have fewer any-disables than baseline, with counts documented (#1341/#1268/#1269).
AbortController+cleanup added to a documented set of useEffect+fetch hooks (#1302/#1064).
Deprecated apiError path now routes through logError/Sentry (central shim) OR a representative migration is done, documented either way (#1222).
Response-format changes (if any) are backward compatible with their clients updated in lockstep; otherwise documented as deferred (#1300/#1093).
CSP: only safe tightenings applied; script-src unsafe-inline retained with documented rationale tying full fix to #657 (#1070).
Missing form validations added for the low-risk cases, remainder documented (#1342).
#422 acknowledged with a deferral note and split recommendation.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run test:unit all pass; ESLint warning count did not increase.
verification: grep -rn "key: string\]: any" types/env.d.ts || echo 'Window any removed'
grep -rc "console.error" app/api --include=*.ts | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print "api console.error total:", s}'
